$comment: Scripts that must run on the Node runtime instead of Bun (D-003, R-051). Checked by scripts/check-runtime.ts.

node.reason: Cloudflare's Vite plugin (miniflare) crashes under the Bun runtime: `this.#runtimeDispatcher?.close is not a function`.
`wrangler dev` prints Ready under the Bun runtime but every request hangs.

Under `bun --bun`, child processes see Bun as `node`, so Playwright's Cloudflare web server (`astro dev`) crashes the same way as S0-3. The runner itself stays on Node; the Node demo it starts still runs on Bun (`bun --bun astro dev`).
node.evidence: VALIDATION.md W-003 (miniflare `this.#runtimeDispatcher?.close is not a function` under `bun --bun playwright test`)

node.reason: Same as `.#e2e`: the runner starts the Cloudflare dev server and `wrangler dev`, which crash or hang under the Bun runtime (S0-3). The Node demo it starts still runs on Bun.
